Decent, clean option with good food in Ortakent The hotel is pretty good for the money. The rooms are minimal and very clean, the a/c works well, and the staff tries to be responsive. The breakfasts are quite delicious. There were two odd things- one is they were reluctant to give more than one key per room so we struggled to gain access if someone was sleeping. Second is that they forced people out of the pool before 8 pm which seems unnecessary (can understand wanting more quiet or less music). I would also encourage the staff to share more information about how to access the Ortakent boardwalk and shops— directions were vague and making information clear would be helpful for tourists who don’t want to just sit at the resort every day. There is a windsurf/SUP/hobie rental next door which was lovely. Also a small gym or space for exercise with a/c would be terrific!
